senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.
Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
ex.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

ex.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
ex.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

senses.en: to find information, or to raise your eyes

ex.en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
ex.zh: 在词典里查这个词。

ex.en: Things are looking up for our team.
ex.zh: 我们队的情况正在好转。

tip: look up 表示“查阅（资料）”；look up to 是“尊敬”。
scene: A student looking up a word in a dictionary at a desk.

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

col: a major employer｜大型用人单位
tip: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

senses.en: To an extremely high degree.
In a way that is surprising or hard to believe.

ex.en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
ex.zh: 汤特别烫，所以我等了一会儿。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can be incredibly valuable to older residents who no longer drive.
ex.zh: 对于不再开车的老年居民来说，可靠的公共交通可能极其重要。

tip: 常修饰形容词或副词；句首可表示“难以置信的是”。

senses.en: used in speech to check understanding

ex.en: You know, the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你知道的，车站附近那家新咖啡馆。

ex.en: It's a really nice place, you know.
ex.zh: 那是个很棒的地方，你懂的。

tip: you know 是口语填充语，用于引出对方已知的信息。
scene: Two friends chatting at a table, one gesturing with a hand.

senses.en: the bright flash of light in a storm

ex.en: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中闪电照亮了天空。

ex.en: We saw lightning in the distance.
ex.zh: 我们看到了远处的闪电。

tip: lightning 是闪电；thunder 是雷声。
scene: A bright lightning bolt striking across a dark stormy sky.

senses.en: to hit someone to the ground, or to destroy a building

ex.en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
ex.zh: 大风把旧篱笆刮倒了。

ex.en: They plan to knock down the old building.
ex.zh: 他们计划拆除旧楼。

tip: knock down 表示“撞倒/拆除”。
scene: A digger knocking down an old brick wall.

senses.en: not any of the people or things being considered
not at all, used before certain comparative expressions

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
ex.zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。

ex.en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
ex.zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

col: none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

senses.en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

ex.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
ex.zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。

ex.en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
ex.zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。

tip: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

senses.en: likely to damage physical or mental health
not in good physical condition
harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems

ex.en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
ex.zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。

ex.en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
ex.zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。

col: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食
an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式
tip: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

senses.en: correct and free from mistakes
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
ex.zh: 这台厨房秤的精度足以用来做面包。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.zh: 科学的；符合科学方法的
senses.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
ex.zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。

ex.en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

tip: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

senses.en: immediately, right now

ex.en: Come here at once! It's important.
ex.zh: 马上过来！有重要的事。

ex.en: She answered the phone at once.
ex.zh: 她立刻接了电话。

tip: at once 是“立刻、马上”的意思。
scene: A parent calling a child to come at once from the doorway.

senses.en: The work done to get ready for something.

ex.en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
ex.zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。

ex.en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
ex.zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。

tip: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

senses.en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you.
A sudden feeling of fear or worry.
To make someone frightened or worried.

ex.en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。

ex.en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。

tip: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

senses.en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.

ex.en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。

ex.en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
ex.zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。

col: a professional certificate｜专业资格证书
tip: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.
Not bright or sunny.
Having an edge that does not cut easily.

ex.en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。

ex.en: Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.
ex.zh: 如果学生很少有机会提问或独立探索想法，课堂就可能显得枯燥。

tip: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

senses.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
ex.zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

ex.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
ex.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

tip: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
ex.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

ex.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
ex.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: information that makes something easier to understand
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her simple explanation helped me understand the new game.
ex.zh: 她简单的讲解让我明白了这个新游戏。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: Before a planned event or a particular time.

ex.en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
ex.zh: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。

ex.en: Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.
ex.zh: 早早公布咨询会日期，可以让更多居民参与地方规划决策。

tip: in advance可独立用；接事件用in advance of。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.

ex.en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
ex.zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。

ex.en: Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.
ex.zh: 如果第一份工作很少提供运用所学技能的机会，毕业生可能会感到失望。

col: disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

senses.en: A strong protective covering worn on the head

ex.en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
ex.zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
ex.zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

senses.en: shining with many small flashes of light
containing bubbles of gas

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；才华横溢的
senses.en: lively, clever, and entertaining

ex.en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
ex.zh: 她把闪闪发亮的手链举到阳光下。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
ex.zh: 餐厅可以供应本地过滤的气泡水，代替进口瓶装水，从而减少包装废弃物。

tip: 饮用水中sparkling指含气泡，still指无气泡。

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

ex.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
ex.zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。

ex.en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
ex.zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。

col: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤
tip: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

senses.en: on the farther side of something
outside a particular limit, range, or ability
at or towards a place farther away

ex.en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。

ex.en: The benefits of university education extend beyond employment prospects to include personal growth and greater social awareness.
ex.zh: 大学教育的益处不仅限于就业前景，还包括个人成长和更强的社会意识。

tip: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。

senses.en: Try to win or succeed against others.
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Several bakeries compete for customers on our street.
ex.zh: 我们街上的几家面包店都在争取顾客。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
to officially give someone something they request
to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

ex.en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
ex.zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。

ex.en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。

col: apply for a grant｜申请补助金
take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

senses.en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement.
Not too expensive.
Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.

ex.en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。

ex.en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
ex.zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。

tip: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

senses.en: a country in the south-west Pacific Ocean

ex.en: My aunt lives in Australia.
ex.zh: 我姑姑住在澳大利亚。

ex.en: Australia is famous for its beaches and wildlife.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚以海滩和野生动物闻名。

tip: Australia 是专有名词，注意首字母大写；澳大利亚人叫 Australian。
scene: A beach with kangaroos and the Sydney Opera House in the background.

senses.en: to use something as the starting point

ex.en: The film is based on a true story.
ex.zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

ex.en: You should base your answer on the facts.
ex.zh: 你的回答应该以事实为依据。

tip: be based on 是“基于、以…为依据”，被动形式很常用。
scene: A film poster next to a book, showing the film is based on the book.

senses.en: a small camera used with a computer

ex.en: She turns off her webcam during online classes.
ex.zh: 上网课时她会关闭摄像头。

ex.en: The webcam has a built-in microphone.
ex.zh: 这个摄像头内置麦克风。

tip: webcam 是电脑摄像头，用于视频通话。
scene: A small webcam sitting on top of a laptop screen.

senses.en: able to live or act without relying on others
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
ex.zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to break into pieces

ex.en: They broke up after three years together.
ex.zh: 他们在一起三年后分手了。

ex.en: The ice on the lake broke up in spring.
ex.zh: 春天湖面的冰裂开了。

tip: break up 常见义为“分手”；也指“解散、破碎”。
scene: Two people walking away in different directions on a street.

senses.en: on something, especially in formal or literary language
immediately after or at the time of an event

ex.en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
ex.zh: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。

ex.en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
ex.zh: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。

tip: 比on正式；upon doing表示“一……就”。

senses.en: to continue to be in the same state
to stay in a place rather than leave
to still exist after other things have gone

ex.en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
ex.zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, private cars remain the main means of travel in many rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，私家车仍是许多农村地区的主要出行工具。

col: remain a challenge｜仍是一项挑战
remain to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。

senses.en: the value of one currency in another

ex.en: The exchange rate between the two currencies changed today.
ex.zh: 今天这两种货币的汇率变了。

ex.en: You can check the exchange rate online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上查汇率。

tip: exchange rate 是汇率；currency exchange 是货币兑换。
scene: A currency exchange board showing different exchange rates.

senses.en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.

ex.en: Her first novel became a bestseller within weeks.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说几周内就成了畅销书。

ex.en: A bestseller can introduce complex scientific ideas to readers who rarely engage with academic publications.
ex.zh: 畅销书能向很少接触学术出版物的读者介绍复杂的科学概念。

tip: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

senses.en: to build, hang or raise something

ex.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们在花园里搭了一顶帐篷。

ex.en: Please put up your hand if you know the answer.
ex.zh: 知道答案请举手。

tip: put up 有“搭起、张贴、举起”等义。
scene: Two people putting up a tent in a garden.

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
ex.zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。

tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

senses.en: to stop trying or stop doing something

ex.en: Don't give up; you are doing well!
ex.zh: 别放弃，你做得很好！

ex.en: He gave up smoking last year.
ex.zh: 他去年戒烟了。

tip: give up 表示“放弃”或“戒除（习惯）”。
scene: A coach encouraging a tired runner not to give up.

senses.en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship.
To hope very strongly that something will happen.

ex.en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
ex.zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
ex.zh: 提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。

tip: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

senses.en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground.
Wild, uncultivated land, especially in Australia or Africa.

ex.en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。

ex.en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。

tip: 灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。

senses.en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly

ex.en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
ex.zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。

ex.en: A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
ex.zh: 食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。

tip: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

senses.en: to remove something unwanted

ex.en: We need to get rid of this old sofa.
ex.zh: 我们需要扔掉这张旧沙发。

ex.en: He got rid of his bad habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他改掉了熬夜的坏习惯。

tip: get rid of 是“摆脱/处理掉”。
scene: Two people carrying an old sofa out of a house.

senses.en: very pleasant or attractive in a way that delights people

ex.en: We found a charming little café beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边发现了一家迷人的小咖啡馆。

ex.en: Preserving charming historic neighbourhoods can attract visitors while strengthening residents' sense of belonging to their city.
ex.zh: 保护迷人的历史街区可以吸引游客，同时增强居民对城市的归属感。

tip: 既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

senses.en: to relax completely

ex.en: We chilled out by the pool all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

ex.en: Chill out! Everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 冷静点！一切都会好的。

tip: chill out 是口语“放松、冷静”。
scene: A person relaxing in a pool chair with sunglasses and a drink.

senses.en: a person who protects a building or people

ex.en: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
ex.zh: 保安在入口检查了我们的包。

ex.en: A security guard watches the building at night.
ex.zh: 保安夜里看守大楼。

tip: security guard 是保安/警卫人员。
scene: A security guard in uniform checking bags at a building entrance.

senses.en: The act of reaching a place.
A person or thing that has recently reached a place.

ex.en: Our arrival at the campsite was delayed by heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨耽误了我们抵达营地的时间。

ex.en: The arrival of faster rail services has made smaller towns more attractive to commuters seeking affordable housing.
ex.zh: 更快捷的铁路服务使小城镇对寻求可负担住房的通勤者更有吸引力。

col: arrival at the airport｜抵达机场
tip: on arrival意为一到达，相当于upon arrival。

senses.en: making you feel sad because it is not as good as hoped

ex.en: The film was disappointing; the ending was weak.
ex.zh: 这部电影令人失望，结尾很弱。

ex.en: It was disappointing that it rained on our picnic.
ex.zh: 野餐时下雨真让人失望。

tip: disappointing 形容事物；disappointed 形容人的感受。
scene: A person walking out of a cinema shaking their head.

senses.en: in person, looking at each other

ex.en: We talked face to face instead of texting.
ex.zh: 我们面对面交谈而不是发短信。

ex.en: She wanted to meet the singer face to face.
ex.zh: 她想和歌手面对面见面。

tip: face to face 是“面对面地”。
scene: Two people sitting across a table talking face to face.

senses.en: Happening often or at short intervals
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: Frequent buses make getting to the market easy.
ex.zh: 公交车班次密集，去市场很方便。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: mathematics (American English)

ex.en: Math is my favourite subject at school.
ex.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

ex.en: She is good at math and science.
ex.zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

tip: math 是美式说法；英式说 maths。
scene: A blackboard with maths equations written on it.

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
ex.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

ex.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
ex.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
tip: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

senses.en: Unable to see.
Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems.
A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.

ex.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
ex.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。

ex.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。

col: blind to the risks｜无视风险
tip: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

senses.en: relaxed and not formal
done occasionally rather than regularly or permanently
done without much attention or serious thought

ex.en: You can wear casual clothes to dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚吃饭你可以穿休闲服。

ex.en: Casual employment offers flexibility, but workers may lack the financial security associated with permanent jobs.
ex.zh: 临时工作提供了灵活性，但从业者可能缺乏固定工作带来的经济保障。

tip: casual可指穿着随意，也可指工作非长期固定。

senses.en: on or towards the right side

ex.en: The shops are on the right-hand side of the street.
ex.zh: 商店在街道右侧。

ex.en: She is my right-hand helper in the office.
ex.zh: 她是我在办公室的得力助手。

tip: right-hand 是“右侧的”；right-hand side 右侧。
scene: A street with shops lined up on the right-hand side.

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

col: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

col: button up a coat｜扣好外套
sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

senses.en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.

ex.en: The cattle gathered under a tree during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，牛群聚集在一棵树下。

ex.en: Raising cattle requires substantial land and water, which can place pressure on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 养牛需要大量土地和水，这可能给当地生态系统带来压力。

tip: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。

senses.en: the part of a country's military that uses planes

ex.en: His uncle is a pilot in the air force.
ex.zh: 他叔叔是空军飞行员。

ex.en: The air force held an air show at the airport.
ex.zh: 空军在机场举行了飞行表演。

tip: air force 是空军；navy 海军，army 陆军。
scene: Military jets flying in formation over an airfield.

senses.en: A plant substance used to add flavour to food.
To add spices to food.
Something that makes an experience more interesting or exciting.

ex.en: This warming spice gives the soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 这种带来暖意的香料让汤的味道十分美妙。

ex.en: The historical spice trade connected distant societies and encouraged the exchange of agricultural knowledge and cooking techniques.
ex.zh: 历史上的香料贸易连接了遥远的社会，并促进了农业知识与烹饪技术的交流。

tip: spice不一定辣；spice up也可指增添趣味。

senses.en: a person who plays the guitar

ex.en: The guitarist played a beautiful solo.
ex.zh: 吉他手演奏了一段优美的独奏。

ex.en: She is a guitarist in a rock band.
ex.zh: 她是一支摇滚乐队的吉他手。

tip: guitarist 是吉他手；pianist 钢琴手。
scene: A guitarist playing an acoustic guitar on a small stage.

senses.en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean
Loose earth, especially on the ground

ex.en: Please wipe the dirt off your shoes before entering.
ex.zh: 进来之前，请把鞋上的泥污擦掉。

ex.en: Regular handwashing removes dirt and reduces the spread of infections in schools and other shared spaces.
ex.zh: 经常洗手可以去除污垢，减少学校及其他公共场所的感染传播。

tip: 通常不可数；表示“泥土”时多见于美式英语。

senses.en: a person who supports a team or an idea

ex.en: The football supporters cheered loudly.
ex.zh: 足球迷们大声欢呼。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the environment.
ex.zh: 她是环保的坚定支持者。

tip: supporter 是“支持者”；体育场景中指球迷。
scene: Football supporters cheering with scarves in a stadium.

senses.en: A glass or plastic device that produces electric light.
A rounded underground plant part that stores food and grows shoots.

ex.en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时，厨房的灯泡坏了。

ex.en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
ex.zh: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以减少家庭用电量，并降低长期成本。

tip: 既指灯泡，也指洋葱、水仙等植物的鳞茎。

senses.en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds
grain crops such as wheat or barley, especially in British English

ex.en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
ex.zh: 我们烤了新鲜玉米，配着黄油一起吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing corn may need more efficient irrigation systems as droughts become increasingly frequent.
ex.zh: 随着干旱日益频繁，种植玉米的农民可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

tip: 美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。

senses.en: not true or based on facts
made to resemble something real or natural
intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions

ex.en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
ex.zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。

ex.en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
ex.zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。

tip: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

senses.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement
to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。

ex.en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
ex.zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。

col: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事
insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

senses.en: to visit briefly, or to phone in

ex.en: She called in to see us on her way home.
ex.zh: 她回家路上顺便来看我们。

ex.en: Listeners can call in to the radio show.
ex.zh: 听众可以打电话进广播节目。

tip: call in 表示“顺便来访”或“打电话进来”。
scene: A friend popping by the front door with a small gift.

senses.en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float.
To remove dust from a surface.
To cover something lightly with a powder.

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰
dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
ex.zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。

ex.en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
ex.zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。

col: the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel

ex.en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。

ex.en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。

tip: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

senses.en: a person who shares a room or flat with you

ex.en: My roommate is from Italy.
ex.zh: 我的室友来自意大利。

ex.en: She gets on well with her roommate.
ex.zh: 她和室友相处得很好。

tip: roommate 是室友；英式分房间共享说 flatmate/housemate。
scene: Two roommates chatting in a shared bedroom.

senses.en: wide; including many things

ex.en: They crossed a broad river by boat.
ex.zh: 他们乘船渡过一条宽阔的河。

ex.en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
ex.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

tip: broad 与 wide 都指“宽”；broad 也引申为“广泛的”。
scene: A wide river with a boat crossing under a bridge.

senses.en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere.
To unfairly take away something valuable or important.

ex.en: Someone tried to rob the shop near our house.
ex.zh: 有人试图抢劫我们家附近的商店。

ex.en: Long working hours can rob parents of valuable opportunities to spend time with their children.
ex.zh: 过长的工作时间可能使父母失去与孩子共度时光的宝贵机会。

col: rob someone of something｜抢走某人某物
rob someone of opportunities｜剥夺某人的机会
tip: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

senses.en: To be real or present in the world.
To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.

ex.en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
ex.zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？

ex.en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。

col: exist in nature｜存在于自然界
exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

senses.en: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected.
Used with would to express a preference.
Used to correct or make a previous statement more accurate.

ex.en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
ex.zh: 这汤有点咸，不过面包很好吃。

ex.en: Many commuters would rather cycle to work if safer routes were available throughout the city.
ex.zh: 如果全市都有更安全的骑行路线，许多通勤者会更愿意骑车上班。

tip: would rather后接动词原形；rather than意为“而不是”。

senses.en: not important

ex.en: The colour of the box is unimportant.
ex.zh: 盒子的颜色不重要。

ex.en: Don't worry about unimportant details.
ex.zh: 别为无关紧要的细节担心。

tip: unimportant 是 important 的反义词“不重要的”。
scene: A person ignoring small unimportant papers on a desk.

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

ex.en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
ex.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。

ex.en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
ex.zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。

col: work as a postman｜当邮递员
the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

senses.en: to refer to someone or something briefly
a brief reference to someone or something

ex.en: Did you mention the broken window to the landlord?
ex.zh: 你向房东提过那扇坏了的窗户吗？

ex.en: Reports on urban transport often mention congestion but overlook the needs of people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 城市交通报告经常提到拥堵，却忽视行动不便人群的需求。

col: mention something to someone｜向某人提及某事
tip: 直接接所提内容：mention sth，不用 mention about。

senses.en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.

ex.en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 幸好，我在公交车到站前找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.
ex.zh: 幸运的是，水处理技术的改进帮助许多社区减少了可预防疾病的传播。

col: fortunately for us｜对我们来说幸运的是
fortunately, nobody was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip: 常置于句首，后加逗号，评价整件事令人庆幸。

senses.en: an area protected from direct sunlight
a particular form of a colour
to protect something from direct light

ex.en: We rested in the shade beneath a large tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵大树下的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Planting trees along urban streets provides shade and can reduce residents' exposure to extreme summer heat.
ex.zh: 沿城市街道种树可以提供荫凉，减少居民受到夏季酷热的影响。

col: a shade of blue｜一种蓝色调
shade your eyes｜遮住眼睛挡光
tip: shade常指阴凉区域；shadow指物体投下的影子。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
ex.zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。

ex.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
ex.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

col: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡
roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子
tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

senses.en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again
waste materials collected to be processed and used again

ex.en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
ex.zh: 我们这栋楼分别设有回收物桶和厨余垃圾桶。

ex.en: Effective recycling programmes require convenient collection services as well as clear public guidance on sorting household waste.
ex.zh: 有效的回收利用计划既需要便利的收集服务，也需要向公众明确说明如何分类生活垃圾。

tip: 通常不可数；表示回收活动或待回收的物品。

senses.en: to become something different

ex.en: The old factory turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 旧工厂变成了博物馆。

ex.en: Water turns into ice when it freezes.
ex.zh: 水结冰时变成冰。

tip: turn into 表示“变成”；turn A into B 把A变成B。
scene: An old factory building converted into a museum with visitors.

senses.en: actually; used to give more information

ex.en: I thought he was a teacher; in fact, he's a doctor.
ex.zh: 我以为他是老师，事实上他是医生。

ex.en: In fact, the city is quite small.
ex.zh: 事实上，这座城市很小。

tip: in fact 用来纠正或补充事实。
scene: Two people talking, one correcting the other with a fact.

senses.en: a dangerous and exciting sport

ex.en: Skydiving is an extreme sport.
ex.zh: 跳伞是一项极限运动。

ex.en: He loves extreme sports like rock climbing.
ex.zh: 他喜欢攀岩之类的极限运动。

tip: extreme sport 是极限运动，如跳伞、攀岩、冲浪等。
scene: A rock climber scaling a steep cliff face.

senses.en: always telling other people what to do

ex.en: Her older sister is a bit bossy.
ex.zh: 她姐姐有点爱发号施令。

ex.en: Don't be so bossy; let everyone decide.
ex.zh: 别这么专横，让大家自己决定。

tip: bossy 是形容词，形容喜欢指挥别人的人。
scene: A girl pointing and giving orders to friends in a playground.

senses.en: a room or building equipped for scientific work

ex.en: We wore safety glasses inside the school laboratory.
ex.zh: 我们在学校实验室里戴着护目镜。

ex.en: Investment in laboratory equipment enables university students to develop practical skills and conduct reliable experiments.
ex.zh: 投资实验室设备能让大学生培养实践技能并开展可靠的实验。

tip: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。

senses.en: If this does not happen or is not done.
In all other ways apart from the one mentioned.
In a different way or with a different result.

ex.en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you will get wet.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，否则你会淋湿的。

ex.en: Cities must invest in reliable public transport; otherwise, more residents may choose to drive.
ex.zh: 城市必须投资建设可靠的公共交通，否则更多居民可能选择开车。

col: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明
otherwise healthy｜除此之外身体健康
tip: 表示“否则”时，书面语常在前面用分号。

senses.en: Give someone confidence or support to do something
Make an activity or development more likely

ex.en: My sister encouraged me to join the swimming club.
ex.zh: 姐姐鼓励我加入游泳俱乐部。

ex.en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。

col: encourage someone to do something｜鼓励某人做某事
tip: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

senses.en: So surprising or unlikely that it is hard to believe.
Extremely good or bad, causing strong surprise.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was unbelievable at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出时山上的景色美得令人难以置信。

ex.en: Some online advertisements promise unbelievable results, making it difficult for consumers to distinguish evidence from exaggeration.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告承诺令人难以置信的效果，使消费者难以区分实证与夸大宣传。

col: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事
tip: 既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。

senses.en: a medicine that stops pain and fever

ex.en: She took an aspirin for her headache.
ex.zh: 她吃了片阿司匹林治头痛。

ex.en: Aspirin can help with a fever.
ex.zh: 阿司匹林有助于退烧。

col: take an aspirin｜吃一片阿司匹林
tip: take an aspirin 吃阿司匹林；服药说 take medicine。
scene: A hand taking a white medicine tablet out of a small packet.

senses.en: to be formed from particular parts or members
to have something as the essential feature

ex.en: Our picnic lunch consists of sandwiches, fruit, and juice.
ex.zh: 我们的野餐午饭有三明治、水果和果汁。

ex.en: An effective recycling programme consists of convenient collection services and clear guidance for local residents.
ex.zh: 有效的回收计划包括便捷的收集服务和面向当地居民的明确指引。

tip: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。

senses.en: Happening once a year or relating to a whole year
A book or magazine published once each year
A plant that completes its life cycle within one year

ex.en: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。

ex.en: The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
ex.zh: 年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。

tip: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

senses.en: Hair growing above the upper lip.

ex.en: My uncle carefully trims his moustache every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我叔叔每个星期天都会仔细修剪他的小胡子。

ex.en: In historical portraits, a carefully styled moustache often reflected contemporary ideas about fashion and social status.
ex.zh: 在历史肖像画中，精心打理的小胡子往往反映了当时关于时尚和社会地位的观念。

col: a thick moustache｜浓密的小胡子
tip: moustache指上唇胡须；beard指下巴等处的胡须。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

ex.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
ex.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

col: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人
tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。
